title: 3D-printed shadow masks for micro-patterned electrodes
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34586-34593
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06298A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chanwook Cha, Eunhwa Jo, Yeongjun Kim, Andrew Jaeyong Choi, Koohee Han
Streamlined production of micro-patterned electrodes using 3D-printed shadow masks provides a faster, cost-effective solution for rapid prototyping and iterative design, supporting the advancement of diverse lab-on-chip applications.
